description: This file contains functions and classes for processing, converting, and analyzing build performance test reports, including XML to JSON conversions, metadata aggregation, and statistical analysis of measurements.

classes.name: MeasurementVal
classes.description: Base class representing measurement values with visualization formatting.

classes.name: TimeVal
classes.description: Class representing time measurement values with formatting and splitting into hours, minutes, seconds.

classes.name: SizeVal
classes.description: Class representing size measurement values with formatting in KiB, MiB, GiB.

methods.name: isofmt_to_timestamp
methods.description: Converts ISO 8601 timestamp string to Unix timestamp.

methods.name: metadata_xml_to_json
methods.description: Converts metadata XML element into JSON format.

methods.name: results_xml_to_json
methods.description: Converts results XML element into JSON format, including measurements and test cases.

methods.name: aggregate_metadata
methods.description: Aggregates multiple metadata dictionaries into one, performing sanity checks.

methods.name: aggregate_data
methods.description: Aggregates multiple test result JSON structures into one combined structure.

methods.name: measurement_stats
methods.description: Calculates statistical metrics (mean, stdev, variance, min, max) for a measurement.
